system.description:
Choose one of the following
suppression modes and make an
Interface Roll against all targets within
Far range. Targets you succeed against
experience its effects until the GM
spends a Fear on their turn to end this
protocol.
1- Cryofoam Flood: You rupture cryo-
canisters, coolant lines, or emergency
suppression tanks across the zone.
Deal 2d20+8 techno damage and
targets are temporarily Vulnerable.
2- Vector Fan Grid: You activate
industrial fans, turbine drones,
pressure vents, traffic barriers, or
directional force engines. Deal 3d10+10
techno damage and choose a direction
the pressure is moving. Targets can’t
move against that direction.
3- Chaffstorm Screen: You flood the
zone with dust, chaff, smoke, scrap
particles, sensor noise, and hostile
visibility interference. Deal 5d6+9
techno damage. Attacks made from
beyond Melee range have
disadvantage.
